title: Multi-Round Interleaved Syndrome-Work Circuits and Response-Call Degree Audit

scope.one_call_interleaved_theorem: Arbitrary L-round label-only word/syndrome interleaved circuits are pinched by uniform-secret averaging onto the frequency-fibre blocks C_A(E_eff) = sum_sigma Pi_sigma E_eff Pi_sigma
scope.diagonal_word_multi_round_conservation: For arbitrary L-round interleaved T_f^(+-1) and noncommuting syndrome unitaries W_l, every syndrome readout sector satisfies E_s overlap <= C_A and the sector-average across all N syndrome basis states equals the exact fibre collision value
scope.two_call_response_interleaving: Applying the response phase gate D_y twice interleaved with a label-only mixer pinches uniform-secret acceptance onto the 4-tuple additive relation f_A(w_1)+f_A(w_2) = f_A(v_1)+f_A(v_2) mod q
